newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Glory considers buying Beijing asset.
newsitem.headline: Top Glory considers buying Beijing asset.

text.p: Top Glory International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it is considering the purchase of a controlling stake in Beijing COFCO Plaza from its intermediate holding company Top Glory Holding Co Ltd.
In statement, managing director Xue Guoping said the company was "only exploring the possibility of acquiring the asset".
"No definite decision has been made to proceed with such acquisition or on the timing and terms thereof," he said.
Trading in Top Glory shares was due to resume on Wednesday after a one-day suspension.
Top Glory International, controlled by China National Cereals Oil and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp (Ceroil), engages in property investment and food related business.
